text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how wonderful... Doubling the 
equipment count for the Umamusume's 
sake...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Delight! Indeed, that's it, that's it! 
—However, it is still not enough!

"...I peeked inside the room where the 
conversation was coming from."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A promise! Let us make this gym ten times— 
no, a hundred times more peerless a 
facility!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
100-fold... Splendid, absolutely splendid! 
As expected of Tracen Academy's 
Chairwoman~...
choice_data_list: Where is there any available land!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Who goes there?! To sound just like 
Tazuna... Ah, it's you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me! Even though I'm in the middle 
of reporting, I got carried away and 
completely forgot about the land...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Pardon me. Inspired by the 
Chairwoman's love for Umamusume, I lost my 
composure for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"However, this extraordinary love for 
Umamusume— Chairwoman Akikawa truly is a 
wonderful person."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As part of the interview, please tell me. 
From Trainer <username>'s perspective, what kind of 
person is the Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
High hopes! I shall take your feedback to 
heart with the utmost sincerity!
choice_data_list: She is a chairwoman worthy of respect.

It feels like they lose control pretty 
often...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Blushing! Being praised so directly is a 
bit embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I remain inexperienced. For the 
sake of the Umamusume, there is still much 
left for me to do.”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Save the word "respect" until 
after the URA Finals succeed!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
“—How moving! What a truly wonderful 
person she is...!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Even while receiving their Trainer's 
recognition, that attitude of never 
settling with who they currently are—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So you have no intention of stopping until 
you've prepared a stage where every 
Umamusume in the world can shine...! 
Marvelous! Please, let me write an article 
about this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Permission granted! Tracen Academy 
spreading its wings to the world— I truly 
hope you continue to write articles about 
it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Let us cooperate, Trainer <username>! Let us strive 
together to make all Umamusume shine!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is Tracen Academy through and 
through... I'm going to write a wonderful 
article out of this~...

...Before I knew it, I had been dragged 
into a global-scale issue.

Even so, deeply moved by her passionate 
spirit, I tackled training with <chrname> with 
renewed enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing! Tazuna does scold me often 
about that, indeed. "Don't just speak on 
momentum alone," she says...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, I implore you! Please forgive 
this as well! It is all so that the 
Umamusume may run a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see. In other words, all of the 
Chairwoman's outbursts stem from her love 
for Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words, as long as it's for the 
Umamusume, you won't hesitate to provide 
any form of support!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Not just from an Umamusume's birth to 
graduation, but providing flawless care 
from retirement all the way into old 
age...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! Let us pledge right here and 
now to support the lives of every 
Umamusume...! By all means! Please write 
an article about it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
M-My apologies! I just got carried away in 
the heat of the moment—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwomaaaaaan! What did you do this 
tiiiiiiime?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: P-Prison break—!

Tazuna-san gave Chairwoman Akikawa a 
strict scolding, telling her, "Do not make 
statements purely on impulse."

Even so, deeply moved by her passionate 
spirit, I tackled training with <chrname> with 
renewed enthusiasm.
